While the biological study focuses on NETs and FXII activation, the mass spectrometry itself was a systemic/unbiased screen without specific PTM enrichment (confirmed by PRIDE metadata 'No PTMs are included in the dataset').

scope: We screened postmortem lung tissues from COVID-19 patients (n=3) using a systemic proteomics approach.

A 100 µm slice per paraformaldehyde fixed lung tissue of Covid-19 infected and control lung tissue was lysed in 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate and 1% w/w sodium deoxycholate buffer boiled at 95 °C for 60 min and sonicated with a probe sonicator to destroy DNA/RNA.
